name: convolute_paid_spell_resolves
notes: P87cbe0b609 G4. Printed: 'Counter target spell unless its controller pays {4}.' Seat 0 casts Disfigure ({B}) at seat 1's 2/2 Bear with {B} plus exactly four more mana in its pool. Seat 1 answers the window with Convolute ({2}{U}, spent exactly). At resolution seat 0 (the countered spell's controller) is asked to pay and pays {4}, spending its pool to the last mana: Disfigure is not countered and the Bear dies. Converted 2026-11-11 to real priority (docs/DESIGN_PRIORITY.md): the response window is gone, so the answer is a spell cast while the first waits on the stack ("hold").
